parameters.name: FileId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the knowledge base file.

parameters.name: InheritSpaceStrategy
parameters.description: Specifies whether to restore inheritance of the chunking strategy from the knowledge space. When this parameter is set to true, ShardingStrategyConfig cannot be specified at the same time.

parameters.name: KnowledgeBaseId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the knowledge base.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the knowledge base resides.

parameters.name: ShardingStrategyConfig
parameters.description: The file-level chunking strategy configuration. This parameter is required when InheritSpaceStrategy is not set to true.
